ground_truth.cypher:

WHERE head.name =~'.*[H|h]a.*'
RETURN head.head_ID,head.name

T2C_6453.query: Find the shortest path between Journal where name is Topology and Keyword, with key_id equal 5d6533e2a77e3daabc184ee8f2441597, including the nodes on the path!

ground_truth.cypher:
MATCH p=shortestPath((a:Journal{name:'Topology'})-[*]-(e:Keyword{key_id:'5d6533e2a77e3daabc184ee8f2441597'}))
RETURN nodes(p)

T2C_13814.query: Identify the longest path originating from Topic for which cluster is 6, and list the properties of the nodes on the path!

ground_truth.cypher:
MATCH p=(a:Topic{cluster:'6'})-[*]->(n)
RETURN p, nodes(p)
ORDER BY LENGTH(p) DESC

T2C_7565.query: Find the Journal with a journal_id starting with J, and linked with an Article through PUBLISHED_IN relationship. The Article must have title: Log mirror symmetry and local mirror symmetry and be PUBLISHED_IN with year recorded!

ground_truth.cypher:
MATCH (n:Article {title: 'Log mirror symmetry and local mirror symmetry'}) -[r:PUBLISHED_IN]- (m:Journal)
WHERE m.journal_id STARTS WITH 'J' AND r.year IS NOT NULL
RETURN n.journal_id
